title: Liaoning Youchuang Phase I Agrochemical Manufacturing Project
summary: Tongyang was deeply involved in the Phase I project through the engineering, manufacturing and supply of multiple key equipment packages, including MVR non-standard equipment, stainless steel pressure vessels and 13 stainless steel thin-film evaporators. body:
Project Background

Liaoning Youchuang Plant Protection Co., Ltd. Phase I is a fine chemical manufacturing project involving multiple process equipment packages.

Tongyang participated in the project through three major equipment procurement packages, covering MVR non-standard equipment, stainless steel pressure vessels and stainless steel thin-film evaporators.

Tongyang's Role & Scope of Involvement

Tongyang was deeply involved in the project-specific equipment engineering, manufacturing and delivery of multiple key equipment packages.

The scope included:

  • MVR Non-standard Equipment: Manufacturing and supply of customized equipment for the MVR evaporation system.

  • Stainless Steel Pressure Vessels: Manufacturing and supply of pressure vessels for production workshops, covering Lots 1-3 and 2-1.

  • Thin-Film Evaporators: Manufacturing and supply of 13 stainless steel thin-film evaporators.

Tongyang undertook equipment-related technical coordination, fabrication, quality control, inspection and delivery in accordance with the project specifications and procurement requirements.

Project Procurement Value

The three awarded packages had a combined contract value of approximately RMB 17.49 million.

This project demonstrates Tongyang's capabilities in customized process equipment manufacturing for fine chemical production facilities, particularly in MVR-related equipment, stainless steel pressure vessels and industrial evaporation systems.
